finding.text: `Servex/doc/task-loop.md` lists every other daily job (`follow_up_daily`, `handover_daily`, `undone_asks_daily`, lines 105–109) but not the new `TaskLoop.twins_daily` (`Servex/TaskLoop.js:156`). Add one "Done (2026-11-01)" line in the same shape: what it runs, which file it keeps, what it posts, and that Servex must restart to pick it up (law 9).

The first time `twins_daily` runs there is no `session-twins.json`, so all 1,408 existing twins count as new and Servex posts a risk note, "1408 sessions got a second folder… a writer went around SessionFolders" (diff.patch:630). That note is false: these twins are the old 2026-10-09 leftovers, still waiting for the fold. Fix: on the first run (no file yet), write the list without posting, or set `session-twins.json` up as part of landing.

A fresh agent can't land this from the task folder alone. `session.jsonl` stops after the docs commit (ebb9c5335): it never says the review is pending, never names the merge command, and has no "can it happen again: no, because …" line, all three of which the brief's Land fence asks for. It also doesn't record the order: merge, then `node Servex/sustain.mjs --restart` and a dev-server restart, then `SessionConsolidate.mjs --all --apply`. That order is written only in `doc/one-folder.md:768`. Add a next-steps log line.

`ChildLinks.sessions` no longer keys a tab-era flat task folder by its line-1 `assign.session_id` (diff.patch:81–83). The log says 69 ids were dropped and each was checked by hand. Any child whose parent link went through one of those folders now resolves to nothing, so it is worth one line in ChildLinks' header comment.

`AISessionIndex.dir_of` (diff.patch:692) skips `Session.locate`'s old step that moved a flat `<id>/` folder into its day. If any flat folders are still left directly under `sessions/`, index.json now goes to a new dated folder beside them. This is probably harmless (the move was a migration), but nothing says so.

`SessionFolders.all()` (diff.patch:979) trusts the saved map whenever every listed folder still checks out. A second folder made later by a writer that skipped the finder is only seen at the next miss or `twins()`. That is acceptable because the daily check exists for exactly this; just be aware of it.
Found during the work and not caused by it: `Server/AskIndex-tasks.test.mjs:22` also fails on the original `AskIndex.mjs` (session.jsonl, 17:02 log). File it as a task so it isn't lost.

The task folder points at the wrong branch. `session.jsonl` ("TO LAND") says to merge `worktree/session-twins-fix` (tip 3484124b8), but this diff is `worktree/mb-twins` (tip 9fa967bbc: a merge of the fix into current dev, plus the `Server/readme.md` line and the removal of ChildLinks' unused `UUID`). No file in the task folder mentions `mb-twins`, and the last line is a `stop` ("dropped: owner dormant"). A fresh agent would merge the older branch and lose the readme line. Add a log line that names `worktree/mb-twins` as the branch to merge, says who made it, and repeats the three landing steps.

The finder's temp file will wake the dev watcher. `SessionFolders.save()` (diff.patch:992) writes `session-folders.json.<pid>.tmp`. `Server/watch.js:56` skips only names that end in `.json` or contain `.tmp-`, so this name gets through. The map is saved on every refresh that sees a change, which means every new session or task folder in any process, so each one sends a stray event (and maybe a reload) through the one public/ watcher. Use `Runtime.safe_write` (its `.tmp-` sibling is already ignored), or name the file `session-folders.tmp-<pid>.json`. Also drop the `.gitignore` line at diff.patch:13 to match.

`session-folders.json` holds every day's folder names (about 13.5k entries). It is rewritten whole on each change, by every process that runs the finder (Servex, the dev server, every hook and `TaskDirs --new` run). That is correct, because it is only a cache and the rename is atomic, but it costs a lot of writes. Worth measuring the file's size, and how often it is written, once this is live.

`AskIndex.session_dir` (diff.patch:44) no longer remembers a lookup, so every ask asks `SessionFolders.of()`. The fast path makes that cheap (under 2 ms, one-folder.md (diff.patch:791)), so this is fine; the comment says it is on purpose.

The first review's findings are all answered in this diff: `task-loop.md (diff.patch:664)` lists `twins_daily`; the first run posts one "started" note instead of a false alarm (`SessionConsolidate.check`, diff.patch:408–417; TaskLoop.js, diff.patch:648); ChildLinks says which 69 ids it dropped (diff.patch:79–81); one-folder.md (diff.patch:791) says what happens to old flat folders now; the AskIndex-tasks failure was filed as a todo (commit 921e7cd23).
